newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU to link aid for insurer GAN to 1998 sell-off - source.
newsitem.headline: EU to link aid for insurer GAN to 1998 sell-off - source.

text.p: The European Commission will approve the French government's 20 billion francs of aid for GAN in exchange for a privatisation of the ailing insurer by June 30, 1998, a source close to the deal said on Tuesday.
Commission sources said on Monday that the state aid package would be approved at the Commission's weekly meeting on Wednesday.
The package consists of a capital injection of 11 billion francs and a further nine billion in state guarantees to cover property losses.
GAN's CIC bank network will also have to be sold off, either with GAN or separately, the source said.
A further condition is the disposal of half GAN's network outside France in the 12 months after privatisation.
